definitions.gloss: something one is looking for; searching for something
definitions.explanation: A thing one is trying to find, or the act of looking for it. Very common in everyday speech, as in {探|さが}し{物|もの}をする and {探|さが}し{物|もの}が{見|み}つかる.

examples.japanese: {探|さが}し{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{探|さが}し{物|もの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: I finally found what I was looking for.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{探|さが}し{物|もの}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧にしないよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{置|お}き→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めている→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: So as not to waste time looking for things in the morning, I keep my keys in a fixed place.

notes:
The noun form of ⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧ (to look for) + ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (thing).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {探|さが}し{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to look for something
- {探|さが}し{物|もの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかる→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧: to find what one was looking for
- {探|さが}し{物|もの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: what are you looking for? (shop staff)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{落|お}とし{物|もの}→落とし物：08450_otoshimono⟧: something someone dropped or lost — from the point of view of the thing lost
- ⟦{忘|わす}れ{物|もの}→忘れ物：01758_wasuremono⟧: something left behind
